default/31587.htm.text: Gemcutter Gedrik: Welcome! Can I interest you in any gemstones today? If you have a rough stone, I'd be happy to cut it into a beautiful gemstone for you! I'm the most skilled craftsman in these parts! I assure you all of my work is 100% guaranteed!

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/1-01.htm.text: Gemcutter Gedrik: You want me to make you an Ice Crystal Gemstone? I'd love to, but ice crystal ore is rare. I've never seen any, and you'd be lucky to come by it. Bring me some and I'll try.

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/1-03.htm.text: Gemcutter Gedrik: I've got the tools and the design ready.

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/1-04.htm.text: Gemcutter Gedrik: Whoever requested this gemstone must want it badly, eh?

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/1-05.htm.text: Gemcutter Gedrik: Rumors abound, but the most reliable one seems to be the one in which a monster in the hot springs region is in possession of ice crystals. Go to the hot springs area and speak with Jeremy who has a catering service there. I've heard that many people obtained ice crystals while he…

Q00084_SagaOfTheGhostSentinel/1-06.htm.text: Gemcutter Gedrik: Here's the Ice Crystal Gemstone! Tell people it was made by Gedrik of Goddard!
